text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper is a non-review research article that synthesizes and compares bottom-up and top-down estimates of greenhouse gas emissions (CO₂, CH₄, N₂O) across Africa over 1990–2018. It does not include any land use/land cover (LULC) future prediction or simulation. While it analyzes historical LULUCF (Land Use, Land-Use Change and Forestry) CO₂ fluxes using inventories, FAO data, DGVMs, and inversions, its focus is on emission accounting and uncertainty assessment—not on predicting or modeling future LULC change. The study lacks future scenarios, spatially explicit LULC projections, and quantitative LULC prediction accuracy metrics. Thus, it fails core inclusion criteria for LULC prediction and meets the exclusion criterion “No LULC prediction component.”)
